Svg.doc: An icon name resolved to its SVG data, and what counts as a name.

Defaults.doc:
Where a field's default icon comes from when the stored value is empty:
the fieldset's own default, walked out of the context.

in `IconifyDefault\Defaults`. Split in WP7d, code moved verbatim.
